collection_policy_gap.legacy_reason_documented: README.md:88 states old local Agent hook binding caused startup failure; exclusion was retained as a compatibility policy. Necessity for the current bundled version has not been independently established.
collection_policy_gap.effect: The configured plugin remains loaded, but this Agent hook binding is removed. DEVELOPER_HOOK_TRACE boundary records from that hook are absent. Built-in model recovery diagnostics still use the same file writer.

generation_chain: Framework model invocation/validation/recovery emits a model-recovery diagnostic record
Benchmark archives the container home and copies log members without changing original file bytes
export_difference: Only completed-framework-traces.ndjson adds _bench task/attempt/source metadata. The per-task native file is not reformatted.
limits: Existing model-recovery records do not replace the missing developer-hook-trace boundary records. Parsing cannot reconstruct events that were not collected. Current frozen configuration must remain unchanged; any new Agent execution or recapture needs user approval.
